mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before requesting a quote for an extra bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for an extra bedroom addition, gather your property survey, list your functional priorities, and establish a clear budget before your initial consultation. Check your property survey for boundary lines, easements, and utility paths that dictate where an addition can physically sit. Decide whether the room needs a dedicated closet, attached bathroom, or private exterior entrance, and consider how you want the exterior stucco and roofing to blend with your current home. Having these details ready helps our estimators evaluate feasibility quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify your room layout needs (such as closets or bathrooms), set a budget, and note how the space should integrate with existing architecture.
